column1: “Anyone who has never made a mistake has never tried anything new.”
column2: “A lady's imagination is very rapid; it jumps from admiration to love, from love to matrimony in a moment.”
column3: “Remember, if the time should come when you have to make a choice between what is right and what is easy, remember what happened to a boy who was good, and kind, and brave, because he strayed across the path of Lord Voldemort. Remember Cedric Diggory.”
column4: “I declare after all there is no enjoyment like reading! How much sooner one tires of any thing than of a book! -- When I have a house of my own, I shall be miserable if I have not an excellent library.”
column5: “There are few people whom I really love, and still fewer of whom I think well. The more I see of the world, the more am I dissatisfied with it; and every day confirms my belief of the inconsistency of all human characters, and of the little dependence that can be placed on the appearance of merit or sense.”
column6: “Some day you will be old enough to start reading fairy tales again.”
column7: “We are not necessarily doubting that God will do the best for us; we are wondering how painful the best will turn out to be.”
column8: “The fear of death follows from the fear of life. A man who lives fully is prepared to die at any time.”
